lines.text: THE Lord is risen indeed Is the glad message true? Those who saw that the Saviour died See Him also risen.
The Lord is risen indeed This is the truth indeed Mercy and truth in warm embrace They were past enemies.
The Lord is risen indeed Thy work is now complete Our Saviour broke the sting of death And power of death vanquished.
The Lord is risen indeed The grave cannot hold Him The saints who died also arose And they shall no more die.
